title: What if you don't sleep for 11 days? 😵
description: In 1964, 17-year-old Randy Gardner stayed awake for 11 days and 25 minutes. Here's what it did to his brain and body. #shorts #science #sleep #humanbody #whatif

scenes.narration: What if you don't sleep for eleven days?
A teenager actually did it in 1964.
After one night, his brain worked like someone who's drunk.
Then microsleeps hit, switching his brain off for seconds.
His immune system got weaker every day.
By day four, he thought a street sign was a person.
Then he slept fourteen hours and woke up fine.
Guinness stopped tracking it. Too dangerous. Would you last three days?
